app.name: OneLiteFeather
app.footer: This page is only for players who received a Ban ID. Your session ends after 30 minutes without activity.

login.title: Appeal your punishment
login.intro: Enter the Ban ID you were shown when you tried to join the network. It lets you see the facts of your punishment, appeal it and talk to the team.
login.label: Ban ID
login.hint: Eight letters and digits, for example K7M2-9QX4. Upper or lower case, spaces and a leading # are fine.
login.invalid: This Ban ID could not be used. Check it and try again.
login.unavailable: The appeal portal cannot be reached right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
login.privacy: Keep your Ban ID private. Anyone who has it can read your punishment, and if it is shared publicly you lose the right to appeal.

expired.title: Your session has ended
expired.body: For your safety you were signed out after a period without activity. Please sign in again with your Ban ID.
expired.draftKept: Text you had not sent yet is kept in this tab until you sign in again or close it.

case.title: Your punishment
case.evidenceCount: {count} item on file | {count} items on file

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.notYet: You can file an appeal from {date}.
appeal.notYetUnknown: It is too early to file an appeal.
appeal.available: You can file one appeal for this punishment.
appeal.open: Your appeal is open. The team will answer in the conversation.
appeal.decided: There is nothing further to appeal here: your appeal has been decided or the punishment is over. You can read the conversation and the decision if there is one.
appeal.cooldown: Your last appeal was denied. You can file a new one from {date}.
appeal.cooldownUnknown: Your last appeal was denied. You can file a new one after a waiting period.

appealForm.title: File an appeal
appealForm.notice: You can have one appeal open per punishment. Explain in your own words why the punishment should be reviewed.
appealForm.label: Your statement
appealForm.hint: Do not include IP addresses, UUIDs or ban codes. Describe your reasons in your own words.
appealForm.filesHint: Attached files are sent in the conversation as soon as the appeal is filed.

errors.NOT_ELIGIBLE: You cannot file an appeal yet. You can file from {date}.
errors.FORFEITED: The right to appeal this punishment was lost because the Ban ID was shared publicly.
errors.FROZEN: This appeal is frozen because the Ban ID was shared publicly.
errors.CONFLICT: An appeal for this punishment already exists.
errors.PII_REJECTED: Please remove IP addresses, UUIDs or ban codes from your text.
errors.VALIDATION: Your statement must be between 1 and 2000 characters.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This Ban ID cannot be used to file an appeal.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Your appeal could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.NOT_ELIGIBLE_NOW: You cannot file an appeal for this punishment right now.
errors.CONDITIONS_CHANGED: The appeal conditions changed while you were writing. Please read them again and confirm them to send your appeal.

conditions.title: Appeal conditions
conditions.confirm: I have read the appeal conditions and I accept them.
conditions.loadFailed: The appeal conditions could not be loaded. Please reload the page.

conversation.title: Conversation with the team
conversation.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter to send. Do not include IP addresses, UUIDs or ban codes.
conversation.loadFailed: The conversation could not be loaded. It will be retried automatically.
conversation.decisionHint: The team's message about the decision is part of the conversation below.

decision.GRANTED_LIFT: Your appeal was granted and the punishment was lifted.
decision.GRANTED_REDUCTION: Your appeal was granted and the punishment was shortened.
decision.OTHER: A decision was made on your appeal.

errors.FROZEN: This conversation is frozen because the Ban ID was shared publicly.
errors.NO_APPEAL: File an appeal before writing a message.
errors.CONFLICT: You cannot write a message right now.
errors.PII_REJECTED: Please remove IP addresses, UUIDs or ban codes from your message.
errors.VALIDATION: Your message must be between 1 and 2000 characters.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This Ban ID cannot be used to write messages.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.

notice.forfeited: The right to appeal this punishment was lost because the Ban ID was shared publicly. The punishment still runs out on its own, and the team can review it on its own initiative.
notice.frozen: Your appeal is frozen because the Ban ID was shared publicly. You can no longer write messages here. The team can still answer and decide, and will contact you another way.
notice.limited: This Ban ID was shared publicly, so only the facts of the punishment are shown. Conversations and decisions are not visible. Contact the team in game if you are the affected player.

chat.dropHere: Drop the files to attach them
chat.formatHint: Formatting: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, lists starting with - or 1., quotes starting with >, and links like [text](https://example.org). There is no preview.
chat.enterHint: Press Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line.

share.title: Shared by the moderation team
share.unavailable: This evidence is no longer available

live.reconnecting: Reconnecting. New messages may take a moment to appear.

errors.TOO_MANY: You can attach at most {max} files to a message.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This file type is not allowed. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or plain text.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.FILE_FLAGGED: The file could not be accepted.
errors.FILE_ACTIVE_CONTENT: The file could not be accepted because it contains active content.
errors.INVALID_FILE: The file could not be accepted.
errors.QUOTA: You have reached the limit of files for this appeal.
errors.NO_APPEAL: File an appeal before attaching files.
errors.FILES_UNAVAILABLE: One of the files is no longer available. Remove it and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Files cannot be added to this conversation.
errors.CONFLICT: The file could not be added right now.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Uploads are unavailable right now. Please try again.

leave.title: You are leaving OneLiteFeather
leave.explain: The next page is not run by OneLiteFeather, and we cannot check what it contains.
leave.warning: Check the address before you continue. Never enter your Ban ID or a password on a page you did not expect.
leave.invalid: This link is not valid. Go back and try again.
